summary: Significantly improved OmniDev website with: (1) richer visual design — gradient text hero, ambient orb backgrounds, hero grid pattern, glassmorphism cards and nav, shimmer CTA button, colored terminal output; (2) syntax-highlighted code viewer with per-token coloring for all 4 demo modes; (3) ⌘K command palette with keyboard navigation, fuzzy search, and 14 quick-launch items; (4) animated mobile nav drawer with open/close icon swap; (5) GitHub stats row (stars, forks, license, release) on the homepage; (6) clickable feature cards that scroll and switch the demo; (7) tech stack section and improved CTA strip; (8) improved downloads page with multi-step source CLI blocks and hover-reveal copy buttons; (9) improved Updates page with status dots and roadmap badges; (10) expanded Docs with 6 sections including AI Agents, icons, terminal-green code blocks; (11) improved License page with 6 third-party notices and license badges; (12) improved Security page with danger alert banner and emoji SLA cards; (13) improved About page with architecture grid and GitHub stats; (14) toast animations (enter/exit keyframes); (15) IIFE-scoped JS, focus-visible ring, text selection style, custom scrollbar, tooltip via CSS; (16) full keyboard routing (Escape closes modals/palette, ⌘K opens palette).
